v: Personally, I LOVED it 😄 Simple revenge story, but Vikram Kumar gives it his own flavour. Nani natural ga rocks... expectations ni konchem pakkana petti chudandi.
e: GangLeader suffers mainly from the huge expectations created by Vikram Kumar and Nani joining hands. Taken on its own terms, though, the deliberately ordinary heroes and villain, subtle comedy and a handful of wonderfully staged scenes make the simple revenge story feel far more distinctive than its plot suggests.
body:
personally I loved the movie!!! this time Vikram came up with a simple revenge story but with special treatment…..special mention of 5 particular scenes (Starting Scene, Interval framing, 2 scenes in second half and the post climax scene reavling Sravani’s char) which stand out to show the intelligence of the director _/\_

the major set back of the film is the expectations out of Vikram post Manam & the deadly combination of Vikram and Nani!!!!! where the audience expect an highely intelligent and entertaining thriller….. but if we watch it without expectations then we can understand the intellegance of the director in coming up with a story where none of the main characters are powerful including the villan but its bot diificult to digest for the regulat audience who are accustomed to poweful villans in Rajamouli and Boyapati type movies!!!!!

Nani was as usual at his Natural best and totally submitted himself to the character!!!!

BGM from Anirudh is trendy and songs could have been better from the guy of his calibre…..

thr movie though with the simple and powerless chars, sublime comedy still holds the grip on audience.

Strictly Not for the audience who expect Powerful Villan/Hero characters (or) those who expect full length comedy entertainer from Nani…..Audience who love different genre movies will connect with it!!!!!

v: Man!!!! What a movie 🙏 College friendship, comedy, emotion, message... anni correct mix lo land ayyayi. Dil Chahta Hai / 3 Idiots zone lo happily pettestha.
e: Chhichhore captures college friendships with characters who feel instantly familiar, then blends that nostalgia with a genuinely meaningful emotional message. Nitesh Tiwari and his writers balance comedy, sentiment and emotion in almost perfect proportions, creating the rare film whose effort and result are both complete successes.
body:
Man!!!! what a movie….I am not exaggerating, but this movie has in it to make it to the list of the likes of #DilChahtaHai #3Idiots & #ZindagiNaMilegiDobara

The film actually made in terms of the above 3 mentioned above but it stands out in its own unique way in the emotinal message it delivers & the realistic way the collage life & chars are protrayed…..We always can find a “Anni” “Sexa” “Acid” “Mummy” & “Bevda” in our group of friends

Director Nitesh Tiwari and his group of writers did a fantastic job with the story, dialogues and screen play by mixing emotion, sentiment and comedy in perfect proportions……..The Screenplay of the movie stands out and is outstanding!!!! thus leaving audience with a feel of watching an Emotional Comedy movie with Sentiment!!!!!

in one word……the film dialogue “its not your result that decides if you are successful or a failure…..but its ur effort that decides it!!!!” sums up the whole movie

but in my view….the Chhichhore team not only succeded in their efforts but also with the results _/\_

v: Ayushmann ki ee subjects select chese dhairyam ekkadi nunchi vasthundo 😄 Naughty setup ni vulgar ga kakunda full fun ga handle chesaru. Supporting gang కూడా rocks.
e: Dream Girl takes a premise that could easily have slipped into cheap or vulgar comedy and handles it with surprising control. Ayushmann is effortlessly convincing, Raaj Shaandilyaa’s writing keeps the jokes lively without crossing the line, and the supporting cast turns the unusual setup into a bright, accessible entertainer.
body:
from where does Ayushmann has got this guts to select the unconventional subjects and effortlessly put such a natural & convincing acting!!!! He is defintly on the path of being the next big thing in Bollywood along with Raj Kumar Rao….

story wise i felt like the content was inspired from #TumhariSulu with a twist of Ayushmann playing the Pooja role……if not handled properly the so called decent audience would have out right rejected the movie as it would have fallen in vulgur category!!!! but thats where the Debut Director & Story/Dialogue Writter #RaajShaandilyaa has shown his talent in making sure the dialogues are spicy and witty enough but never crossed the border to become vulgur (justed wiki’d about him and observed that he had experience of vast writting for Comedy Circus) and the master stroke was selecting a top notch supporting artists who ensured that the content is conveyed perfectly in witty way but never crossing the border!!!!

BGM perfectly complements the mood of the story and the 2 songs are perfect match to the contenet!!!! Visuals were bright and appealing…..

the only drawback (if any) in the movie was the usage of the Hariyani and Utter Pradesh slang in dialogues……which though gave realistic feeling of the places where the story happened but will make bit difficult for audience from other parts of the country to enjoy the movie effortlessly!!!!

v: Puri + Mani + Ram kalisi proper garam masala biryani vandaaru 🔥 Logic pakkana, MASS full ga. Ram energy ento devudike teliyali 😂 Poyiiii kummundri!!!!!
e: iSmart Shankar is Puri Jagannadh going back to unapologetic mass cinema, this time with a sci-fi hook and Ram operating at absurd energy levels. The writing may not have Puri’s hardest-hitting dialogue, but Mani Sharma’s BGM, Ram’s performance and the director’s full-throttle attitude made this exactly the kind of mass feast I wanted.
body:
when 3 baaaps of Mass (Puri, Mani & Ram) come toghther…..the result is Isssssmartish Block Buster _/\_

Puri choose a Masssssssy movie with a scifi backdrop and mannnn he delivers!!!!!! being a Puriiii fan…..I loved all his previous works and this movie was nothing different for me, however Poori has ensured to give that extra mass kick!!!!!

Dialogues wise nothing much hard hitting dialgues from poori this tine but he came with few of the best massy dailogues _/\_

Manisharma gave the best BGM…..esp the BGM in climax gives you instant high!!!!!

Ram _/\_ _/\_ wonder if he was on drug to give such a hyper energitic performance!!!!

finallly…..aaadaaa Poori Mani & Ram kalisi balasinaa potelllu ni kooosi…..garam maasala poosiiiii…..masth birayniiii ondiru…..poyiiiii kumundri!!!!!
